unspecified_scores.reason: Only a stop row starting at 100 h or later (a 9-character clock against the 8-character reserve at rag.py:733) can push a result one character over 3,000; a personal video library has no such videos, and one extra character is harmless.

When a first-segment row is written with its stored text, its removed parts are not added to sent_parts (rag.py:1913-1918); a later supplement for another already-sent row can repeat a line such as a recurring caption, and the user sees nothing beyond a slightly redundant prompt.

A single transcript or OCR row whose group exceeds about 2,929 characters always hits the stop check at rag.py:1910 before anything is written, so any range that reaches it returns only the stop note; the model gets no text from that point and may answer that it cannot find the content.

Only a programming error inside the pure in-memory _serve_transcript (rag.py:1410-1439) can trigger this; the user still gets the fallback answer, and the only side effect is a log line counting earlier rounds.
